name: Suwappu
description: Natural-language quote, price, and discovery agent for Suwappu. A2A swap/quote requests return quotes; A2A does not execute swaps.

bearer.description: Register at POST /v1/agent/register to get an API key (suwappu_sk_...)

skills.name: Natural-language Swap Quote
skills.description: Get a same-chain EVM or Solana swap quote. The aliases swap, quote, convert, and exchange all quote only; A2A never signs, broadcasts, or submits managed execution.
examples: swap 0.5 ETH to USDC on Base
quote 100 USDC to SOL on Solana

skills.name: Token Prices
skills.description: Get current token prices and 24h change for up to 20 symbols.

skills.name: Chain Discovery
skills.description: List the chain set currently exposed by the A2A quote service.

skills.name: Token Discovery
skills.description: List built-in Solana tokens or return guidance to the full MCP/REST token catalog for other chains.

skills.name: Portfolio Integration Hint
skills.description: Given a wallet address, return the MCP/REST endpoints to use for an actual portfolio read. A2A itself does not fetch balances.

skills.name: Suwappu A2A Help
skills.description: Describe the natural-language commands implemented by the hosted A2A route and point builders to MCP/REST for structured access.
